On Beast Awakening Day, Arthur Cronwall receives the worst possible combination in Greenleaf history.
F-Rank Talent.
Goblin Contract Beast.
The ceremony erupts in laughter. To everyone else, goblins are the weakest monsters alive—creatures destined to stay weak forever. Then Arthur awakens a hidden Talent.
Evolution Path Vision.
A power that reveals every possible evolution hidden inside his beasts. And when he looked at the frightened goblin trembling beside him...
[Goblin] --> [Goblin Warrior] --> [Goblin Commander] --> [Goblin King]
A king? If a goblin can become a king... What else is the world wrong about?
Arthur looked at the trembling goblin and smiled.
“They call you disgusting.”
“A mistake.”
“Don't you want to see their faces when you prove them wrong?”
The goblin hesitated and Arthur reached out his hand.
“Come on.”
“Our story starts here.”
Together, they begin turning the world's weakest monsters into legends. Their journey leads through forgotten kingdoms, extinct evolutions, ancient civilizations, and secrets buried beneath history itself. Because some evolution paths don't simply lead to stronger beasts.
They lead to a truth the world was never meant to discover.
